_about: Every currency and point type on Hunsterverse, shown by /currencies.html (js/currencies.js) and found by the site search. Edited by hand: change a line, keep the shape, then run NODE_PATH=/root/work/pw-tools/node_modules node dev/check-currencies.js. Each currency: id (the page anchor #id), name (as the game shows it in English), also (other names: the Discord bot's or common ones), group (one of groups), what (one line), spend ([label, link] pairs, headed "Spent at" or spend_label: link the site's pages, never copy a shop list), cap, items (item ids that ARE this currency: their item page links here), ways (how, amount, limit, optional link; basis = where it was checked, never shown), note (optional, shown under the ways), not_here (what the original game had that this server lacks; basis), settings (live settings the numbers depend on: when one changes, edit the numbers here). Only write what was checked in the live code, the live database or the game's data.

currencies.name: Zenny
currencies.what: The game's basic money. Shops, the smithy and two gachas take it.

ways.amount: The quest's zenny reward. The server's zenny rates are 1.0 (no bonus) for normal and G rank quests.
ways.basis: Erupe handlers_quest.go tune values from live.Rates.Zenny/ZennyNC/GZenny/GZennyNC; server_settings rates zenny, zenny_nc, g_zenny, g_zenny_nc = 1.0 on 2026-11-16. The client computes the amount.

ways.amount: Each item's sell price, shown on its item page.
ways.basis: client-side shop; sell prices from the game's item table (site data/uses/info, hvmhfz_re item_info.json)

ways.amount: Each Road pays two boards (the Road design vote and the Road floors board) by place: 100,000 z for 1st, 75,000 for 2nd, 50,000 for 3rd, 30,000 for 4th-10th and 10,000 for 11th-50th.
ways.limit: Once per board per Road, sent as a gift.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_rest_api road/RoadProperties.java approvedTiers (item type 10); live ~/frontier/config/application.properties has no road.reward.* override (2026-11-16)

currencies.name: GCP
currencies.what: Each character's points from quests and Diva Defense, spent in the Diva shops.

ways.amount: The quest's GCP reward. The server's GCP rate is 1.0 (no bonus).
ways.basis: handlers_quest.go tune value 1020 = live.Rates.GCP*100; handlers_mercenary.go handleMsgMhfSaveMercenary stores the client's GCP; rates.gcp = 1.0

ways.amount: 26 GCP rewards from 500 to 7,100 GCP, reached at 20 to 14,000 event points: 102,000 GCP in all per event.
ways.limit: Each reward once per character per Diva Defense.
ways.basis: diva_rewards list 1 item_type 26: 26 rows per rank class, sum 102000, thresholds 20-14000 (2026-11-16)

ways.amount: 1,000 GCP at Clan progress 13, 2,000 at 17, 3,000 at 26 and 50,000 at 100: 56,000 GCP in all.
ways.limit: Each reward once per member per Diva Defense.
ways.basis: diva_rewards list 2 item_type 26: 4 rows, sum 56000, thresholds 13-100

ways.how: Trade in Guild Point Tkt or Goushu Ticket
ways.amount: 10 GCP each, at the GCP item exchange. The New & Returning Hunter Pack gives 3 Guild Point Tkt once, the Weekly Supply Drop 1 a week, and the gachas have them as prizes.
ways.basis: shop_items shop_type 7 (handlers_shop_gacha.go 'Item->GCP'): items 13190 and 1662, cost 10; event_campaign_items 1001 item 13190 x3, 1002 x1 (repeat weekly)

currencies.name: Frontier Points
currencies.what: Shared by all characters of your account. Spent in the Frontier Points shop.

ways.amount: 328 items trade in for 1, 2 or 3 Frontier Points each, mostly tickets; an item's page says what it trades in for.
ways.limit: None.
ways.basis: fpoint_items buyable=false: 328 rows (fpoints 1: 89, 2: 3, 3: 236); handlers_shop_gacha.go handleMsgMhfExchangeItem2Fpoint adds count x fpoints

ways.amount: 50 Frontier Points with step 2 and 100 with step 3: 150 for a full run of 6 coins.
ways.basis: gacha_entries gacha 103 entry_type 1 and 2: frontier_points 50, 100; handlers_shop_gacha.go step-up adds gacha_entries.frontier_points

ways.amount: Each Road pays two boards by place: 5,000 for 1st, 3,000 for 2nd, 2,000 for 3rd, 1,000 for 4th-10th and 500 for 11th-50th.
ways.limit: Once per board per Road, sent as a gift.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_rest_api RoadProperties.java approvedTiers (item type 21); handlers_distitem.go case 21; no live override

not_here.what: Buying Frontier Points with real money.
not_here.basis: no payment system; only distitem case 21, trade-ins and the step-up add frontier_points (grep of server/channelserver)

currencies.name: Trial Coin G
currencies.what: Gacha coins shared by your account. They pay for the Coin Step-Up and the Coin Lucky Box, and are used before Golden Coin G.

ways.amount: 10 Trial Coin G a week. Claim it from the gift list (Claim Items) at the Gacha Cat or the Guide.
ways.limit: A new gift every Monday 00:05 UTC; each gift once per character, open for 4 weeks.
ways.basis: cron /etc/cron.d/gacha-weekly-coins on hvmhfz-db (Mondays 00:05 UTC); distribution 37-39 'Weekly Gacha Coins 2026-Wnn' item_type 20 x10, times_acceptable 1, deadline +4 weeks; handlers_distitem.go case 20; docs/gacha-design.md 5 and 10

currencies.name: Golden Coin G
currencies.what: The other gacha coin, shared by your account. Pays for the same gachas as Trial Coin G, after your trial coins are used up.

ways.amount: Each Road pays two boards by place: 50 Golden Coin G for 1st, 30 for 2nd, 20 for 3rd and 10 for 4th-10th.
ways.limit: Once per board per Road, sent as a gift.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_rest_api RoadProperties.java approvedTiers (item type 19); handlers_distitem.go case 19; handlers_shop_gacha.go spends gacha_trial before gacha_premium

not_here.what: Buying coins with real money, and the General Store's coin shop (it has nothing for sale).
not_here.basis: shop_items shop_type 6: 0 rows on 2026-11-16; no payment system

currencies.name: N Points
currencies.what: Each character's Net Cafe points, spent in the Net Cafe shop (its list is built into the game). Every account here has the Net Cafe course.

ways.amount: 5 N Points the first time each day; it also refills the day's bonus quests (3) and daily quests (10).
ways.limit: Once a day; the day starts at 03:00 UTC.
ways.basis: handlers_cafe.go handleMsgMhfCheckDailyCafepoint: addPointNetcafe(s, 5), daily_time = JST noon; live daily.bonus_quest_allowance 3, daily_quest_allowance 10

ways.amount: Paid for time logged in during the week: 250 at 30 minutes, 500 at 1 hour, 1,000 at 2 h, 1,250 at 3 h, 1,500 at 5 h, 2,000 at 8 h, 2,500 at 12 h, 3,000 at 16 h, 3,500 at 20 h, 4,000 at 24 h, 5,000 at 34 h, 10,000 at 48 h, 10,000 at 72 h and 100,000 at 167 h.
ways.limit: Each step once a week; the time resets every Monday 00:00 Japan time (Sunday 15:00 UTC).
ways.basis: cafebonus table (14 rows, item_type 17, time_req seconds); handlers_cafe.go acceptCafeBonuses (course 30, LEAST(... maximum_np)), GetCafeDuration weekly reset TimeWeekNext; every account's rights 469766734 include course 26 -> 30 (common/mhfcourse)

not_here.what: Net Cafe bonus quests of real certified Net Cafes.
not_here.basis: mhfpac.tsv 114930 'Net Cafe Bonus Quests, only at Certified Net Cafes'; no certified cafes on this server

currencies.name: RdP
currencies.what: Hunting Road points, paid at the end of each Road quest and spent in the Hunting Road shop.

ways.amount: Set by the monsters you hunt, the difficulty and how far you get.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_re docs/hunting-road.md (settlement 0x10b1e020 -> 0x10b1dc70 adds the run's points to Rd P); live GameplayOptions.DisableRoad false

ways.amount: A tower quest ends with the same settlement, so it pays RdP too.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_re docs/hunting-road.md: the settlement runs at the end of Road quests and tower quests (0x10aff970)

currencies.name: Tower Medal
currencies.what: An item used as money at the Guild Medal Exchange, in the Tower menu of the Hunting Road / Sky Corridor counter.
spend: What the exchange sold in the original game

ways.amount: 5 Tower Medals a day, claimed in the counter's Tower menu under Daily Rewards.
ways.limit: Once a day; the day starts at 00:00 UTC.
ways.basis: live config SkyCorridor.DailyRewards true, DailyRewardItems unset -> sys_tower_daily.go towerDailyDefault 11167 x5; client menu issue: hvmhfz_re docs/progress.md part 205 (v1.30, fix not live)

ways.amount: Six tasks a day: five run tasks worth 2 or 3 medals each and the day's Guardian worth 5. They are added to the daily rewards.
ways.limit: Each task once a day.
ways.basis: live config SkyCorridor.DailyChallenges true; sys_tower_challenges.go towerChallengesFor (towerChallengeMedals {2,3}, towerChallengeGuardianMedals 5)

ways.amount: One-time presents: 10, 15, 25 and 40 medals at 1, 5, 20 and 50 floors climbed; 10 and 25 at 1 and 5 Duremudira clears; 10, 15, 20 and 25 for the first clear of the 1st to 4th District. 195 medals in all.
ways.limit: Each present once per character. Claimed in the Tower menu under Contribution Rewards.
ways.basis: sky_corridor_rewards (kinds floors, clears, district; 2026-11-16); live sky_corridor.present_box true; docs/hvmhfz-sky-corridor.md SK5; hvmhfz_re part 205

ways.amount: 3 in the New & Returning Hunter Pack (once) and 1 in the Weekly Supply Drop.
ways.limit: The weekly one resets every Monday 00:00 Japan time (Sunday 15:00 UTC).
ways.basis: event_campaign_items 1001 item 11167 x3, 1002 x1; event_campaigns 1002 repeat weekly; campaigns.enabled true

ways.amount: Tower Medals are prizes in the gachas.
ways.basis: gacha_items item 11167 in gachas 101-107 (site data/sources gacha-101..107)

currencies.note: In client patch v1.30 the Tower menu's Contribution Rewards and Daily Rewards rows open an empty window (the cursor still works); a fix is ready for the next client patch.

currencies.name: Souls
currencies.what: Hunter Festival points. They are not spent: your own souls and your Clan's souls unlock the festival prizes.

ways.amount: Each trial is worth a set number of souls per hunt: 1 to 18 for most trials, 89 to 400 for three. Souls are handed in when you enter town.
ways.limit: Only during the souls part of a Hunter Festival, in a Clan that has entered a team; at most 500 souls are handed in at a time.
ways.basis: festa_trials reward by objective 1-5 (1-15, 6-18, 1-12, 1, 89-400; 2026-11-16, Erupe defaults); handlers_festa.go chargeFesta; hvmhfz_re docs/festa.md section 3 (500 per charge)

settings: festa_trials table (a new trial list changes the souls per hunt)

currencies.name: Diva Defense points
currencies.what: Your Diva Defense score for the current event. They are not spent: they unlock the Diva Defense reward lists, and your Clan's progress is its members' points.

ways.how: Clear Diva Defense quests in week 1
ways.amount: Points for the monsters you hunt. Each day every prayer gem has 3 bonus Diva quests that pay double monster points.
ways.basis: Erupe docs/hvmhfz-diva.md section 2 (bonus quests: 3 per gem per day at 200 %, diva_bonus_quests 74 hunts); handlers_diva_event.go ADD_UD_POINT (one add capped at 100,000)

ways.how: Hand in tactics points in week 2
ways.amount: Points from the Diva quests you hand in during the guild tactics week.
ways.basis: handlers_diva_event.go ADD_UD_TACTICS_POINT; docs/hvmhfz-diva.md section 2

settings: config Diva.GuildPointsPerStep (100: Clan progress = points / 100, at most 100)

currencies.name: Diva coins
currencies.what: Coins from Diva Defense, kept by each character from one event to the next and spent at the Diva Defense coin exchange (1 to 3 coins an item).

ways.limit: Each reward once per character per Diva Defense.
ways.basis: diva_rewards list 1 item_type 29: 10 rows x1, thresholds 700-6700; shop_items shop_type 9: 12 rows cost 1-3; docs/hvmhfz-diva.md (coins per character, all events)

currencies.name: GW Lottery Ticket
currencies.what: Tickets from the gifts after each event, spent at the Gacha Cat's Event Ticket Box: 1 ticket a draw, 20 empty the box.

ways.amount: 5 tickets, claimed from the gift list (Claim Items) at the Gacha Cat or the Guide.
ways.limit: For every character that delivered souls. Given an hour after the rewards phase starts; open for 28 days.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_ops hvmhfz-db/event-tickets (event-tickets.sql hourly from /etc/cron.d/event-tickets on hvmhfz-db; event_tickets_due in event-tickets-schema.sql): one personal distribution per character, type 1, item_type 7 item 6833 x5, times_acceptable 1, deadline +28 days; gacha 105 costs item 6833 x1 / x5 (docs/gacha-design.md 3); festa: festa_submissions / festa_archive_submissions souls > 0, at T3 + 1 h

ways.amount: 5 tickets, claimed from the gift list (Claim Items) at the Gacha Cat or the Guide.
ways.limit: For every character that earned Diva Defense points (personal or Clan). Given an hour after the reward week starts; open for 28 days.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_ops hvmhfz-db/event-tickets (event-tickets.sql hourly from /etc/cron.d/event-tickets on hvmhfz-db; event_tickets_due in event-tickets-schema.sql): one personal distribution per character, type 1, item_type 7 item 6833 x5, times_acceptable 1, deadline +28 days; gacha 105 costs item 6833 x1 / x5 (docs/gacha-design.md 3); diva: diva_days or diva_tactics points > 0, at start + 14 d + 1 h

ways.amount: 5 tickets, claimed from the gift list (Claim Items) at the Gacha Cat or the Guide.
ways.limit: For every character with at least one Cup clear that week. Given an hour after the week's Cup closes; open for 28 days.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_ops hvmhfz-db/event-tickets (event-tickets.sql hourly from /etc/cron.d/event-tickets on hvmhfz-db; event_tickets_due in event-tickets-schema.sql): one personal distribution per character, type 1, item_type 7 item 6833 x5, times_acceptable 1, deadline +28 days; gacha 105 costs item 6833 x1 / x5 (docs/gacha-design.md 3); speedrun_cup: tournament_results of the cycle, at the cycle's open end + 1 h

ways.amount: 5 tickets, claimed from the gift list (Claim Items) at the Gacha Cat or the Guide.
ways.limit: For every character that signed up. Given an hour after the bracket's cycle ends; open for 28 days.
ways.basis: hvmhfz_ops hvmhfz-db/event-tickets (event-tickets.sql hourly from /etc/cron.d/event-tickets on hvmhfz-db; event_tickets_due in event-tickets-schema.sql): one personal distribution per character, type 1, item_type 7 item 6833 x5, times_acceptable 1, deadline +28 days; gacha 105 costs item 6833 x1 / x5 (docs/gacha-design.md 3); vs_bracket: vs_bracket_entries of the cycle, at the cycle end + 1 h

currencies.note: MezFes, the campaigns and Raviente run all the time and give no tickets.

currencies.name: MezFes tickets
currencies.what: Tickets for the MezFes minigames in Mezeporta Square: solo tickets for the solo games and group tickets for the group games.

ways.amount: 5 solo tickets and 1 group ticket.
ways.limit: Refilled every week, on Monday 00:00 Japan time (Sunday 15:00 UTC). MezFes runs every week.
ways.basis: server/signserver/dsgn_resp.go (live.MezFes.SoloTickets/GroupTickets, event id TimeWeekStart, start TimeWeekNext - duration); server_settings mezfes solo_tickets 5, group_tickets 1, duration_seconds 604800

currencies.name: Clan Points
currencies.what: Points that build up while you are logged in. You donate them to your Clan: for its rank, its Clan room, its Clan events and its Sky Corridor missions.

ways.amount: 1 Clan Point for every 15 minutes played (the Net Cafe rate; every account here has it). Added when you log out; left-over minutes count toward the next point.
ways.basis: handlers.go logoutPlayer: rpGained = timePlayed/900 with course 30 (all accounts), remainder kept in time_played; capped at live.Caps.MaximumRP

currencies.name: Merit
currencies.what: Points HR 999 hunters earn for monsters hunted in quests; spent on the merit-point lottery. What you earn also counts for the weekly Caravan ranking.

ways.amount: Monsters marked in the game's own table are worth a set number of merit points each, times the number hunted. Shown on the quest's result screen.
ways.basis: handlers_kouryou.go handleMsgMhfAddKouryouPoint (adds the client's amount to characters.kouryou_point, addCaravanScore); hvmhfz_re docs/seibattle.md 'Merit points (kouryou)'; live Conquest.CaravanRankings true

not_here.what: Caravan Points (CP) and Pallone gems: the Pallone Caravan is not built on this server.
not_here.basis: handlers_caravan.go: GetRyoudama empty, PostRyoudama not implemented, CaravanMyScore empty lists

not_here.what: The Conquest seasons and the weekly conquest gifts are switched off.
not_here.basis: live config Conquest.Enabled false, WeeklyRewards false; conquest_reward_grants 0 rows (2026-11-16)

currencies.name: Weekly stamps
currencies.what: Two stamp counts (HL and EX) that you trade for tickets at the weekly stamp exchange.

ways.how: One stamp of each kind a week
ways.amount: 1 HL stamp and 1 EX stamp, the first time the game checks after the week starts. 8 HL stamps trade for 5 HL Tkt, 8 EX stamps for 5 EX Tkt, 48 HL stamps for a Yearly Sub Ticket.
ways.limit: One of each a week; the week starts Monday 00:00 Japan time (Sunday 15:00 UTC).
ways.basis: handlers.go handleMsgMhfCheckWeeklyStamp (hl/ex_total +1 when last check < TimeWeekStart), handleMsgMhfExchangeWeeklyStamp (8 -> 1630 x5 / 1631 x5; 48 hl -> 2210 x1)

not_currencies.name: HRP, SRP, GRP and GSRP
not_currencies.text: Rank points: they raise your ranks and are never spent.
